'''2000 Texas State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship held in Texas in spring 2000. [[Justin Warren]] posted the Light deck he and [[Matt Lush]] rebuilt for it, which went 3-0 there.<ref name="dt-6874">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/6874 Soul Reaver], DeckTech (Justin "hoostino" Warren, 18 May 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/6874/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/6874/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 2000 (before 18 May)
* '''Site:''' Texas
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
